market_definition: Polysulfide Sealants comprises polysulfide-based sealant systems valued for chemical resistance, flexibility and long-term sealing in demanding joints. Products supplied for insulating-glass units, infrastructure and industrial environments are included. By Component System • One-Component • Two-Component By Grade • Insulating-Glass Grade • Fuel-Resistant • Chemical-Resistant • Construction Grade By Form • Gun Grade • Pour Grade • Bulk Grade By Application • Insulating Glass • Aircraft Fuel Tanks • Concrete Joints • Industrial Chemical Sealing By End Use • Construction • Aerospace • Automotive • Industrial Processing By Region • North America • Europe • Asia Pacific • Latin America • Middle East • Africa EXCLUDED from the market: Polysulfide coatings, non-sealant elastomers, silicone or polyurethane sealants and separately sold primers. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms. GEOGRAPHY OF THIS LIST: EUROPE - companies headquartered in a European country (EU, United Kingdom, EFTA, Western Balkans, Ukraine, Moldova, Russia).
